name: FIN7
description: FIN7 (also known as Carbon Spider or ELBRUS) is a Russian cybercriminal APT group that has primarily targeted US retail, restaurant, and hospitality sectors since 2015, stealing over $1 billion. They operated through a fake cybersecurity front company called Combi Security to recruit hackers. FIN7 is linked to the Carbanak malware campaign and the DarkSide ransomware group responsible for the Colonial Pipeline attack.

sources.title: How Cyber Crime Group FIN7 Attacked Hundreds of U.S. Companies — FBI
